subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

Statement I: Dobereiner gave the law of triads.

Statement II: Dobereiner tried to arrange the elements with different properties into groups, having three elements each.

options.text: Both statements are correct. Statement II is correct explanation of Statement I.
Both Statements are correct. Statement I is correct explanation of Statement II.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only Statement I is Correct.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Statement I:** Dobereiner gave the law of triads.
 
• **Statement II:** Dobereiner tried to arrange the elements with different properties into groups, having three elements each.
 
• **Explanation:**
 
 
• Johann Wolfgang Döbereiner was a German chemist who is best known for his work that led to the development of the periodic classification of elements.
 
• The Law of Triads, proposed by Döbereiner in 1817, states that the atomic weight of the middle element of a triad is approximately the arithmetic mean of the atomic weights of the other two elements.
 
• Statement I is correct because it accurately describes Döbereiner's contribution to chemistry.
 
• However, Statement II is incorrect because it suggests that Döbereiner tried to arrange elements with different properties into groups. In reality, Döbereiner grouped elements with similar properties into triads.
 
• Therefore, only Statement I is correct, making Option 2 the correct answer.
